style.vernacular: Low-lying Caribbean port city on the Haulover Creek and Belize River: raised timber colonial houses with verandahs and louvres, painted white and pastel, under galvanised-zinc roofs, mixed with poured-concrete commercial blocks and a few early brick buildings built from ship-ballast bricks; Swing Bridge and creek-side stilt houses, palms and almond trees, flat swampy ground.
style.ornament: Timber fretwork and louvred shutters; verandahs and balcony galleries on stilted houses; Georgian arched windows and plastered brick on cathedrals; brightly painted shopfronts in yellow, coral and sky blue; mahogany interiors.
